In Equation 18.7, the collision cross section sc 5 pd2 is the geometric cross section of a sphere that represents the “size” of a molecule. Recall that the factor of 2 arises because we consider only the relative motions of the molecules. We incorpo­ rate this factor in all of the definitions and equations that follow so that the quanti­ ties u, v, and  represent relative speeds, velocities, and energies, respectively. Col­ lision rates defined by Equation 18.7 are often called hard sphere collision rates; to touch is to collide. They can be quite large for gases at 1 atm and 298 K; Z1 for N2 is about 5 3 109 s21 (Example 9.12).
